title: Mailbox
subtitle: Everything that belongs to this one address

quota.title: Storage
quota.recalculated: The mailbox was measured and the mail server will recount.
quota.recalculatedPartly: The mailbox was measured, but the mail server's own total could not be reset. It may still refuse deliveries until it is.

connection.title: Connection settings
connection.description: What to type into a mail client that cannot configure itself.
connection.hostnamePending: No hostname can be given out yet, because no certificate covers one. The ports are already correct; the name follows once the certificate is issued.

autoresponder.subject: Subject
autoresponder.intervalDays: Reply to the same sender at most every
autoresponder.intervalHint: Counted in days. A sender who writes several times in that period gets one reply, not one per message.

forwarding.description: Mail arriving here is sent on to the addresses below.
forwarding.keepCopy: Keep a copy in this mailbox
forwarding.needsADestination: Forwarding needs at least one address to send to.
forwarding.confirmNoCopy: Without a copy, mail arriving here is sent on and then dropped. Nothing will be left in this mailbox to go back to. Continue?
forwarding.savedNotApplied: Forwarding was saved, but the mail server has not picked it up yet, so it is not forwarding anything at the moment.

transfer.exportDescription: Downloads every message and folder as one archive.
transfer.importFormats: Accepts a Maildir archive or an mbox file.
transfer.importFormatsWithPst: Accepts a Maildir archive, an mbox file, or an Outlook .pst export.

migration.title: Bring mail in from another server
migration.description: Copies every folder and message from an existing IMAP mailbox into this one. Nothing on the other server is changed or deleted.
migration.passwordHint: The password is used for this one sign-in and is never stored. It is gone when you close this page.
migration.startHint: The copy runs in the background. You can leave this page; the progress is here when you come back.
migration.confirmCancel: The messages already copied stay in this mailbox, and the rest are not copied. Stop now?

reasons.tlsFailed: The server's certificate could not be checked, so the password was not sent.
reasons.blockedHost: That address is on this server's own network and cannot be used as a source.
reasons.badSecurity: The server does not offer the selected encryption on that port.
reasons.authFailed: The server refused the username or the password.
reasons.basicAuthDisabled: This provider no longer accepts a password for IMAP at all, so the mailbox cannot be copied this way.
reasons.appPasswordRequired: This provider needs an app password created in its own settings, not the ordinary account password.
reasons.timedOut: The copy ran longer than allowed and was stopped.
reasons.interrupted: The panel restarted while the copy was running.
reasons.alreadyRunning: A copy is already running for this mailbox.

errors.verifyFailed: The sign-in could not be checked
errors.startFailed: The copy could not be started
errors.cancelFailed: The copy could not be stopped
errors.loadFailed: The mailbox could not be loaded
errors.recalculateFailed: The mailbox could not be measured
errors.saveAutoresponderFailed: The automatic reply could not be saved
errors.importFailed: The upload could not be imported
errors.exportFailed: The mailbox could not be downloaded
